req.title: PUT is idempotent
req.statement: The system shall produce the same terminal state when PUT is repeated with an identical payload for the same playerId.

doc.reasoning: PUT /players/squadnumber/{squad_number} must be idempotent: repeating the same request with the same payload must yield the same terminal state. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — two identical PUTs both return 204 and the resource state is identical after each; (2) negative NEG — PUT with mismatched squad_number in body vs path returns 400 on every call; (3) boundary BVA — PUT on squad_number=1 (lowest pre-loaded) repeated twice yields 204 both times and state is stable; (4) STC — state-transition: PUT→GET→PUT→GET confirms state does not drift; (5) DT — PUT on non-existent squad_number returns 404 consistently on repeated calls, confirming idempotent error behaviour.

tests.name: test_put_idempotent_positive_two_identical_calls_both_204_state_unchanged
preconditions: Player with squad_number=10 exists in the database (pre-loaded row)
actions: Build a valid PlayerRequestModel payload for squad_number=10
Issue PUT /players/squadnumber/10 with that payload (first call)
Issue PUT /players/squadnumber/10 with the identical payload (second call)
GET /players/squadnumber/10 and assert all fields match the payload
expected: GET after second PUT returns the same field values as after the first PUT
squad_number, first_name, last_name, position are exactly as sent
trace: R-PLAYER-029: identical PUT repeated → same terminal state
EP: valid payload, existing resource — normal idempotency path
Catches mutations: status-code constant (204→200), field-assignment removal
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

payload = {
    "firstName": "Kabir",
    "middleName": "Mary",
    "lastName": "Reddy",
    "dateOfBirth": "1910-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
    "squadNumber": 10,
    "position": "Right Winger",
    "abbrPosition": "DM",
    "team": "River Plate",
    "league": "Ligue 1",
    "starting11": False
}

def test_put_idempotent_positive_two_identical_calls_both_204_state_unchanged():
    r1 = client.put("/players/squadnumber/10", json=payload)
    assert r1.status_code == 204

    r2 = client.put("/players/squadnumber/10", json=payload)
    assert r2.status_code == 204

    r_get = client.get("/players/squadnumber/10")
    assert r_get.status_code == 200
    body = r_get.json()
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 10
    assert body["firstName"] == "Kabir"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Reddy"
    assert body["position"] == "Right Winger"
    assert body["league"] == "Ligue 1"
    assert body["starting11"] == False

preconditions: Player with squad_number=26 exists (highest pre-loaded row)
actions: Build a valid payload for squad_number=26 with modified fields
expected: S1 and S2 are identical: same firstName, lastName, position, team, league, starting11, squadNumber
trace: R-PLAYER-029: state-transition PUT→GET→PUT→GET must produce stable terminal state

tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

payload_sq26 = {
    "firstName": "Aditya",
    "middleName": None,
    "lastName": "Mehta",
    "dateOfBirth": "1926-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
    "squadNumber": 26,
    "position": "Defensive Midfield",
    "abbrPosition": "RB",
    "team": "Liverpool",
    "league": "Serie A",
    "starting11": False
}

def test_put_idempotent_state_transition_put_get_put_get_stable():
    r1 = client.put("/players/squadnumber/26", json=payload_sq26)
    assert r1.status_code == 204

    g1 = client.get("/players/squadnumber/26")
    assert g1.status_code == 200
    s1 = g1.json()

    r2 = client.put("/players/squadnumber/26", json=payload_sq26)
    assert r2.status_code == 204

    g2 = client.get("/players/squadnumber/26")
    assert g2.status_code == 200
    s2 = g2.json()

    assert s1["squadNumber"] == s2["squadNumber"] == 26
    assert s1["firstName"] == s2["firstName"] == "Aditya"
    assert s1["lastName"] == s2["lastName"] == "Mehta"
    assert s1["position"] == s2["position"] == "Defensive Midfield"
    assert s1["team"] == s2["team"] == "Liverpool"
    assert s1["league"] == s2["league"] == "Serie A"
    assert s1["starting11"] == s2["starting11"] == False
    assert s1["id"] == s2["id"]
